request.style: English, acoustic folk, tender clear female vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, mandolin, cello, soft harmonies, hushed like dawn and rising to joy, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She followed him from Galilee when he had set her free
She stood beside the cross of him where others feared to be
She watched them lay him in the tomb and roll the stone in place
And came before the morning light to weep for his dear face

[Verse]
The tomb was standing open and the stone was rolled away
They have taken away my Lord
And I don't know where they have put him
She turned around and saw a man there in the early grey
Thinking he was the gardener, she said
Sir, if you have carried him off
Tell me where you have put him

[Chorus]
Jesus said to her, Mary
She turned to him
Rabboni
I have seen the Lord
I have seen the Lord

[Bridge]
Do not hold on to me
Go to my brothers and tell them
I am ascending to my Father and your Father
To my God and your God

[Chorus]
Jesus said to her, Mary
She turned to him
Rabboni
I have seen the Lord
I have seen the Lord

[Outro]
Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples
I have seen the Lord
